title: Apple just killed the App Store as we know it

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: If Apple's App Store is gone, what does that mean for innovation and control in the digital ecosystem?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: New APIs and open frameworks now let developers bypass Apple's gatekeeping, enabling direct device-to-user connections.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Without Apple's curation, harmful apps, misinformation, and privacy violations could surge unchecked.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are implementing AI-driven security layers and decentralized verification to restore trust and safety.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: A future where open platforms empower creators while AI ensures quality and ethics could redefine digital freedom.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future isn't about control or chaos — it's about designing systems that balance freedom with responsibility.

video_cue: A split-screen showing developers coding on open-source platforms and AI scanning apps for security threats.
